def algorithm(func, dim, lb, ub, budget, rng):
    population_size = 1000
    mutation_rate = 0.01
    sigma_init = 5.0
    sigma_decay = 0.99

    x = np.random.uniform(lb, ub, (population_size, dim))
    sigma = sigma_init
    for _ in range(budget):
        fitness = func(x)
        indices = np.argsort(fitness)
        x_best = x[indices[:int(0.1*population_size)]]
        x_new = x + rng.normal(scale=sigma, size=(population_size, dim))
        mask = (x_new < lb) | (x_new > ub)
        x_new[mask] = np.clip(x_new[mask], lb, ub)
        fitness_new = func(x_new)
        indices = np.argsort(fitness_new)
        x = x_new[indices[:population_size]]
        sigma *= sigma_decay

    return x_best[np.argmin(func(x_best))]
